text: Heisenberg (a chemist really knows how to pick a cool name) enters the chat and makes a deal with Tuco. Hahahaha, Tuco's ‘tight, tight, tight!’ is ridiculously catchy. I heard playing Tuco drained so much of the actor's life force (honestly, no wonder—Tuco Salamanca is pure chaotic energy 😼) that he asked the writers to kill him off ASAP. Hahahahahaha!
